answer: The ember assignment is published and falcon records each panel. Shards are assigned from the forge graph, and hence cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3351 identities would post 3556 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
